summary: Form 8-K filed by Artisan Partners Asset Management Inc. on June 5, 2026, reporting preliminary assets under management (AUM) as of May 31, 2026. Total AUM was $186.0 billion. The filing disclosed that a U.S. sub-advisory mandate representing ~$5.7 billion in the Value Equity strategy is expected to terminate in early June 2026, with a muted revenue impact due to low fees. The filing is a routine monthly AUM update under Item 8.01, not a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendation, or strategic action applies. This is a periodic operational report, not a transformative event.
